deadline.value: For September 2027 entry, submit and pay by January 1 (window opens October 1); documents by January 15. Same dates for international applicants.
deadline.quote: September start: | Application window: October 1 - January 1 (application fee deadline) | Document deadline January 15

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission is granted only once a professor agrees to supervise (and fund) you; contact MIE faculty before or after applying.
supervisor.quote: Students should actively pursue confirming a supervisor as admission can only be granted to students who have secured a supervisor. | PhD applicants are strongly encouraged to contact professors with whom they would like to work, either before or after submitting an application.

funding.value: Admitted full-time PhD students get tuition and fees covered plus at least CAD 26,000 a year for 4 years (5 for direct entry); admission depends on a professor or scholarship providing that funding.
funding.quote: Registered PhD candidates receive enough funding to cover tuition and incidental fees. In addition, PhD candidates receive a minimum of $26,000 per year for up to four years (5 years for PhD direct-entry and fast-track students).

also.quote: these students must be funded, either by external scholarships or by a professor's research funds

entry_route.value: A master's is typical; exceptional bachelor's graduates (A- or higher) can enter the PhD directly if nominated by an MIE professor.
entry_route.quote: Students entering the PhD program typically have a Master’s degree. | Exceptionally strong applicants (GPA: A- or higher) with a bachelor's degree may be nominated by an MIE professor for direct entry to the PhD program.

english_waiver.value: The page conflicts: one section accepts official proof of English instruction, but the application section says MIE requires a test from non-exempt countries such as India even if instruction was in English. Plan to take TOEFL/IELTS.
english_waiver.quote: MIE requires proof of ELP even if their language of instruction and examination was English. | the applicant can provide official documentation from their admitting institution that instruction was in English

notes: Two academic references, at least one a previous thesis supervisor. Aerospace research is in the separate UTIAS PhD (Aerospace Science and Engineering).
